title: Local differentiable extension of the tangent projection near a C² chart point
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ (ℝ^d := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), M ⊆ ℝᴺ, V ⊆ ℝⁿ, W ⊆ ℝᴺ and ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ satisfy Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ. That is: V and W are open, ψ is C² on V, ψ is injective on V, and ψ(V) = W ∩ M. Moreover V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ(x) = fderiv ℝ ψ x is injective for every x ∈ V. Assume (T): tangentSpace M (ψ x) = range Dψ(x) (= LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) for every x ∈ V. Then for every x₀ ∈ V there is Q : ℝᴺ → L(ℝᴺ, ℝᴺ) with three properties. (i) Q is Fréchet differentiable at ψ(x₀). (ii) tangentProjection M z = Q(z) for every z ∈ M in some neighbourhood of ψ(x₀), i.e. tangentProjection M =ᶠ[𝓝[M] ψ x₀] Q. (iii) Q(ψ(x)) = (range Dψ(x)).starProjection, the orthogonal projection of ℝᴺ onto range Dψ(x), for every x in some neighbourhood of x₀. Here tangentProjection M z := (tangentSpace M z).starProjection is the orthogonal projection onto the tangent space of the frozen contract.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 2 M V W ψ → (∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → ∀ x₀ ∈ V, ∃ Q : Rn N → (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N), DifferentiableAt ℝ Q (ψ x₀) ∧ tangentProjection M =ᶠ[𝓝[M] ψ x₀] Q ∧ ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, Q (ψ x) = (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap).starProjection
